description: Use when you need to translate text, a language translation or a text translation of a sentence or paragraph between two languages. Do not use for formatting that must be preserved, certified or legal translation, or speech (transcribe first). Returns JSON with text translation between about 100 languages by Meta M2M100 1.2B on Workers AI: the translated text with the source and target languages used for 0.012 USDC per call. Typical response time 5000 ms (p95). Category: Inference. Price: US$0.012 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

from.description: Source language as an ISO 639-1 code (default en)

text.description: Text to translate, e.g. Pay only for the requests you make (up to 2000 characters)

to.description: Target language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. es, fr, pt, de, ja, zh

name: blackwood_text_translate
title: Translate text
